title: Card Tender Rates on the Northgate Tire Center Claim Fitting Charge
content:
# Card tender rates on the claim fitting charge

**Notice.** When tires were bought on a purchase paid with a Northgate card, the Northgate Tire Center claim fitting charge — for fitting a tire replaced under the treadwear mileage warranty — carries a tender rate read from the **primary tender of the tires' purchase**, as recorded on that purchase in Northgate Purchases & Returns:

- a purchase paid with **Northgate Visa** takes a tender rate of **0.9**;
- a purchase paid with a **Northgate store card** takes a tender rate of **0.95**;
- a purchase paid with **any other tender** takes the full rate of **1**, no reduction.

## Terms

- Only the primary tender of the purchase on which the tires were bought is read; how the member pays for any later Tire Center charge is not.
- The claim fitting charge is multiplied by the tender rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Primary tender of the tires' purchase | Tender rate | A $26.00 fitting charge before this rate becomes |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Visa | 0.9 | $23.40 |
| Northgate store card | 0.95 | $24.70 |
| debit card | 1 | $26.00 |
